🚨 SCPs HAVE ESCAPED INTO THE CITY 🚨

Containment has failed. The streets are no longer safe.

🔫 Arm yourself with powerful weapons
🧬 Face deadly SCP anomalies
🏙️ Explore a ruined, dangerous city
👥 Survive solo or with friends

Each SCP has unique behaviors. Every encounter is unpredictable.

💀 How long can you survive?
The SCP Foundation failed… now it’s your turn.

🔥 ENTER AT YOUR OWN RISK 🔥
